description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'VacancyListRSSControllerTest' for testing the 'VacancyListRSSController' in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It includes setup routines and a test method 'testGenerateRSSFeed' that verifies the RSS feed generation logic, mocking dependencies like URL generation and date/time services.
